description: This file defines the ReviewSearchController class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares a Vue component named 'review-search' with date range properties (from-date and to-date) set to the current year. It is responsible for rendering a review search interface with date filters.

classes.name: ReviewSearchController
classes.description: A controller responsible for rendering a review search interface with date filters, extending the AbstractVueController and utilizing the DateTimeHelperTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes a Vue component named 'review-search' and adds date range properties (from-date and to-date) based on the current year, preparing the component for rendering.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds 'from-date' and 'to-date' properties to the Vue component, setting defaults to the start and end of the current year.
